name: Leraye
source:
He says missing the bull's eye is the hardest thing in the world, and is the most reliable long distance marksman in Gehenna.

Satan has a hobby of removing the heads of everything and collecting them, and Leraye has a hobby of collecting the bodies that Satan has removed and discarded.
